_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::xfem_fluid#5 and a FALSIFICATION of both the key name and the symptoms. The claimed symptoms do not appear either: on the upstream Nitsche weak-Dirichlet deck xfluid_channel_constWDBC_straightCut_hex20_EOS_GP_2ndGP, NIT_STAB_FAC swept from 1e-3 to 1e12 reproduces all four result tests at TOLERANCE 1e-13, exits 0 both times, and never mentions a condition number or an unconverged Newton step. Nitsche's method is consistent, so on a field the space reproduces exactly the penalty weight cancels. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
